runtime_binding.entrypoint: Nine-node organism uses bounded node-specific runtimes; no monolithic second kernel runtime.
runtime_binding.source_of_truth: Repository source + deployed Supabase Edge source + persisted proof receipts; exact-current parity is node-specific and must be reread.

acceptance: A runtime is not considered living merely because this registry exists; behavioral, outcome, causal, production and successor proof are separate gates.

SELF.proof_boundary: Identity anchor exists; universal SELF behavioral influence across every task is not claimed.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Explicit owner binding failure cannot authorize an orphan runtime.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: source/identity test only; not production proof.

LAW.proof_boundary: Deployed Edge source equals current repository source; prior bounded authorize/refuse proof exists. Latest-main end-to-end chain still requires fresh production proof.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Wrong scope, expiry, revocation, and authority-missing paths must refuse.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

ACT.proof_boundary: Deployed Edge source equals current repository source; bounded live ACT proof exists. Exact-current multi-request/idempotency proof remains a separate rung.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Stale/malformed LAW time or broader Door authority must refuse before execution.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

KNOW.consumes: fresh AUTHORIZED LAW receipt for bounded parent naya_node_apply context
KNOW.proof_boundary: Live function is active but deployed source does not equal current Graph V2 repository source. Do not claim current-main Graph V2 production behavior.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Stale/future LAW time, wrong owner, or wrong grant target must refuse before private reads.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

PROVE.reads: current live authority + owner-scoped selected Intelligent Block + provenance/evidence + contradiction/invalidation relationships
PROVE.epistemic_rule: claim strength never exceeds evidence strength; conflicts block promotion
PROVE.proof_boundary: Deployed Edge source equals current repository source; bounded proof exists, but current full-chain outcome remains separately gated.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Missing/stale KNOW evidence or caller-supplied proof content must fail closed.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

CONNECT.proof_boundary: Graph V2 contract is ratified and selector source merged. Live KNOW is stale to current source, so current Graph V2 influence is not production-proven.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Unverified relationship evidence must not produce contextual verified support.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

VERIFY.proof_boundary: nayanet-causal-verify deployed source equals current repo; nayanet-learning-verify does not. Verification capability is bounded, not universal current-main proof.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Missing/forged paired receipts or outcomes must fail closed.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

LEARN.persisted_transitions: learning candidates + Intelligent Blocks + checkpoint/verification receipts
LEARN.proof_boundary: Live components exist, but current repository sources are not fully deployed. Learning claims still require verified future behavioral effect.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Missing provenance, authority, evidence, or checkpoint state must refuse promotion and preserve state.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

EVOLVE.persisted_transitions: learning_evidence + nayanet_intelligent_blocks + nayanet_brain_relationships + execution receipts; nayanet_successor_handoffs table exists as canonical persistence substrate
EVOLVE.proof_boundary: Bounded cold-successor reconstruction and independent reread exist historically/current source, but exact-current deployed parity, generic successor package runtime, A→B→C continuity and bounded self-building are not universally production-proven.
EVOLVE.phantom_binding_reconciliation: nayanet-successor-handoff is not present on current main and is no longer claimed as an active runtime entrypoint. Restore it only if future evidence establishes it as the canonical seam.

behavioral_contract.falsifier: Related reuse may be reconstructed; unrelated transfer and inherited authority must be refused.
behavioral_contract.production_boundary: local runtime-handler execution only; not production proof.

binding_truth_rule: Every one of the nine nodes must have exactly one canonical binding entry with an executable, persisted transition surface, and an explicit proof boundary. Binding existence is not proof of current-main production parity or universal behavioral influence.
